capabilities.summary: Turn one existing action into a durable event record while updating every visible projection exactly once
prerequisites: an existing entity-changing user action
stable entity identifiers
visible status or summary projections
user_actions: perform the existing action on one eligible entity
refresh and inspect the affected entity and history
verification: the entity, summaries, history, and announcement change once
an ineligible repeat does not create a duplicate event

capabilities.summary: Derive a grouped count and latest-event summary from an existing structured event history
prerequisites: structured events with stable entity fields
a grouping field already present in the host data
user_actions: create events for two different groups
inspect the grouped summary
verification: only the affected group changes after a new event
counts are derived from recorded events rather than unrelated entity state

capabilities.summary: Save a named view of an existing filter and restore the same visible results after refresh
prerequisites: an existing filterable collection
a current filter value and derived visible results
user_actions: set a filter and save it under a name
change the filter, reload, and apply the saved view
verification: applying the view restores both the control value and visible result set
saved views persist without mutating the underlying entities

capabilities.summary: Make two existing derived views consume the same active filter while preserving their shared source data
prerequisites: one persistent active view or filter
one independent derived summary
a shared raw collection from which both views can be recomputed
user_actions: apply and clear a saved view
compare the visible collection with the derived summary
verification: both derived views change together from the same raw collection
the underlying entity state and unrelated totals do not change

capabilities.summary: Keep a selected working set independent of search and filtering, including items currently hidden from view
prerequisites: a filterable collection with stable entity identifiers
item selection controls
user_actions: select an item, hide it with a filter, and reveal it again
clear the whole working set
verification: hidden selections remain counted and selected
global selected count is distinguished from visible selected count

capabilities.summary: Represent the active filter and selected detail in the URL and restore them through refresh, Back, and Forward
prerequisites: an existing filterable collection
an item detail view with stable identifiers
user_actions: filter and open two details
reload, use Back and Forward, and open a deep URL
verification: the click path and direct URL converge to the same visible state
Back and Forward restore distinct prior selections without reload

capabilities.summary: Open an item detail and return to exactly the previous search, filter, scroll, and focused item context
prerequisites: a searchable or filterable item collection
an item detail surface
user_actions: set collection context, open a detail, and return
repeat after changing the collection context
verification: the prior filter, query, scroll position, and focus are restored
detail content does not overwrite collection state

capabilities.summary: Stage changes to multiple selected records and apply them as one explicit bulk commit with a truthful result summary
prerequisites: stable selected entity identifiers
an existing per-entity field that can be changed locally
user_actions: select several records and stage one field change
commit once and inspect affected and skipped counts
verification: only eligible selected records change
the summary matches actual changed and skipped entities

capabilities.summary: Give an existing modal or dialog a complete keyboard focus lifecycle, including escape and focus restoration
prerequisites: an action that opens a modal surface
a stable trigger control
user_actions: open the dialog, tab through controls, press Escape, and reopen
close through the visible control
verification: focus enters and remains within the open dialog
closing restores focus to the trigger and hides the dialog

capabilities.summary: Reconcile an archive set and a comparison selection so an archived entity is atomically removed from active selection
prerequisites: an existing persistent archive
an existing stable-id comparison or selection workspace
user_actions: select an entity and then archive it
restore the same entity
verification: archiving removes the entity from active selection in the same visible transition
restoring does not silently reselect it
